notes.title: Info about Divine Justice realese
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44965043/f4394d33292616dcb243deaaadc6fd2226efd5ab.png[/img]
We have news. Divine Justice was not
cancelled, but it was delayed until 2025.

We did not develop the game enough this year.
For Divine Justice, this year is really
bad... Because we could not make an interesting
story. We have tons of different stories for the game, 
but finally we have an interesting story.

What about the Steam page. The Steam page
will be redesigned, we are already halfway done
with the page redesign, but we need to add some new
screenshots and stuff.

The development is currently frozen, and we will continue 
development of Divine Justice in December.
You can also expect a trailer in December.

Thank you for your patience!

-HoYR Entertainment
